categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: 月刊ホビージャパンで連載の外伝『境界戦機 フロストフラワー』より、メイレスビャクチと並び“際の極光”で運用される機体セツロを商品化。
description.en: From the side story ``Kyoukai Senki Frost Flower'' serialized in Hobby Japan, we have commercialized the aircraft Setsuro, which is operated in the ``Aurora no Kyokuhin'' along with Meires Byakuchi.

description.ja: ブルーを基調とした機体カラーを成形色で再現。武装を新規造形で再現。
description.en: The blue-based aircraft color is reproduced with molding color. Weapons are reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: ●　「セツロ」機体カラーリングを再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the "Setsuro" aircraft coloring

description.ja: 北米同盟が使用する旧型機体ジョーハウンドを鹵獲、チューンアップしたセツロをブルーとグレーを基調とした成形色で再現。
description.en: The old model Jawhound used by the North American Alliance was captured and the tuned-up Setsuro is reproduced in molding colors based on blue and gray.

description.ja: ●　各種武装、装備が新規造形で付属
description.en: ● Various weapons and equipment are included in new shapes.

description.ja: ウインチユニット、グレネード予備弾ケースが新規造形で付属。さらに脚部スレッド装着状態をパーツ選択式で再現可能。
description.en: A winch unit and a spare grenade bullet case are included with new modeling. Furthermore, the state in which the leg threads are attached can be reproduced by selecting parts.

description.ja: ウインチユニット
description.en: winch unit

description.ja: 肩部に装着するウインチユニットは射出状態をリード線で再現。展開状態のアンカーパーツが付属。
description.en: The winch unit attached to the shoulder reproduces the injection state with lead wires. Anchor parts in expanded state are included.

description.ja: 脚部スレッド
description.en: leg thread

description.ja: 脚部は通常状態に加え、湿地帯移動用装備「スレッド」装着状態をパーツの選択式で再現。
description.en: In addition to the normal state of the legs, the state with the "sled" equipment for moving in wetlands is reproduced by selecting parts.

description.ja: ●　駐機状態を再現可能
description.en: ● Parked aircraft condition can be reproduced

description.ja: 脚部の関節機構により、膝立ちでの駐機状態が再現可能。
description.en: The joint mechanism in the legs allows you to recreate the parking situation while standing on your knees.

description.ja: ●　新規書き下ろしフルカラーパッケージでお届け
description.en: ● Delivered in a newly written full color package

description.ja: 付属武装： ウインチユニット装備 ／ アンカー（ツメ展開） ／ 腰背部ウェポンラック（スペア弾倉付） ／ グレネード予備弾ケース　／ ライフル ／ 脚部スレッド
description.en: Attached weapons: Winch unit equipment / Anchor (claw deployment) / Waist back weapon rack (with spare magazine) / Grenade spare bullet case / Rifle / Leg thread
